name: strix-governance
description: SGRF v1 governance-review skills for Claude Code — the system, change, and release lenses, plus strix-wire to wire a first governed action and strix-onboard to take a new client organization from no configuration to an independently verified governed action. strix-wire asks once for read-only analysis (WIRE-CONSENT-1), then pauses only at the source-change and execution decisions; strix-onboard (ONBOARD-1) pauses only at the governed smoke test and derives readiness from verified proof. Advisory by default; runtime-aware when a Strix runtime is present.
